# VortexVouchers  

VortexVouchers is a simple but powerful voucher system built for modern Minecraft servers. It lets you create custom voucher items that players can redeem for rewards like boosters, commands, or permissions, while giving you full control over when and how those vouchers can be used.

It’s designed to be flexible enough for large servers, but easy to manage even if you don’t want to deal with complex setups.

_(More preview images can be found on the [Wiki](https://wiki.vortexdevelopment.net/projects/vortexvouchers) page, contact support on our [Discord](https://dc.vortexdevelopment.net/) server)_

---

### **What can you do with it?**

You can create voucher items that:

1. Run console or player commands when used  
2. Give boosters, rewards, or one-time perks  
3. Act as event rewards, shop items, or seasonal items  
4. Are protected against duplication or abuse  

Everything is handled through clean config files or an in-game GUI.
### **Conditions that actually make sense**

Vouchers don’t have to be "use anywhere, anytime".

You can restrict usage based on:

1. Player permissions  
2. Gamemode  
3. Health, food, or other stats  
4. Any PlaceholderAPI value  

If a player doesn’t meet the requirements, the voucher simply won’t work and they’ll get a clear message explaining why.
### **Built-in anti-dupe protection**

VortexVouchers keeps track of claimed vouchers to prevent abuse.  
This means vouchers can’t be redeemed multiple times unless you explicitly allow it.

If you ever need to reset claims for wipes, testing, or new seasons, you can do it with a single command.
### **Easy to manage for staff**

Admins get a simple GUI to:

1. View all vouchers  
2. Edit and manage them in-game  
3. Give vouchers to players quickly  

No need to constantly dig through config files just to make small changes.
### **Works with your existing setup**

VortexVouchers integrates cleanly with:

1. PlaceholderAPI  
2. LuckPerms  
3. Modern Paper servers  

### **Configuration & Documentation**
Every configuration file is meticulously documented to ensure a smooth setup experience, even for beginners. 
Previews and more on the wiki page!


*Stop fighting your plugins. Start running your server.*
